title: Analyzing the Gap Between Safety Framework Promises and Deployment Decisions

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling and critical: directly testing whether RSP-triggered evaluations are followed addresses the most important governance question at frontier labs -- whether safety commitments bind behavior.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: identifying RSP thresholds and checking releases against them requires careful reading of technical and policy documents, manageable with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Sustained effort: covering multiple labs, their RSP documents, and all post-RSP releases requires thorough research but has clear boundaries.

evidence: arXiv:2603.10015 'The Coordination Gap in Frontier AI Safety Policies' (March 2026) analyzes RSP implementation gaps across labs, finding external verification covers <20% of capability evaluations
AI Lab Watch (ailabwatch.org) tracks RSP documents and compares lab safety policies systematically
METR 'Common Elements of Frontier AI Safety Policies' provides comparative analysis of safety frameworks
EA Forum 'We read every labs safety plan' (2025) provides detailed cross-lab comparison
Specific cases documented: Anthropic RSP v3 weakening, OpenAI safety protocol rewrites (Feb 2026)
